test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Generally, in India population census is conducted after how many years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**10**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In India,** the population **census** is typically conducted once every** 10 years.**
 
• **The decennial census** is carried out by the Office of the Registrar** General and Census Commissioner of India,** which operates under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
 
• **The population census in India **aims to collect** comprehensive data on the country's population, including information on demographic, social, economic, and other relevant factors.**
 
• It is conducted to assess **the size, growth rate, distribution, and characteristics** of the population across various geographic regions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The census process involves the enumeration of every individual residing within the boundaries of India, regardless of their citizenship status.
 
• The data collected includes information such as** age, sex, occupation, education, marital status, religion, language, and other relevant socio-economic indicators.**
 
• This data is crucial for **planning and implementing various development programs, policies, and resource allocation strategies**.
 
• **The census** plays a significant role in understanding **population trends, identifying areas that require specific attention, and aiding decision-making processes at both national and local levels.**
